name: comete_sc_pmap_fusion
author: INRIA
description: From a set of files generated by comete_sc_T2_STIR for a given patient and session (2 T2Sag images and 2 corresponding probability maps), this pipeline fuses the upper and lower spinal cord acquisitions and produces combined lesion information for that patient/examination: a combined segmentation mask, a combined probability map, and a YAML/TSV report on the volume and location of lesions, along with QC elements.
command-line: export PATH=:/sct/spinalcordtoolbox/bin:$PATH ;  unzip [PMAP_ARCHIVE] -d input_pmap; mkdir input_pmap/pmap; mv input_pmap/*/* input_pmap/pmap; echo 'ARCHIVE PMAP :'; ls input_pmap/pmap;  unzip [T2_ARCHIVE] -d input_t2; mkdir input_t2/t2; mv input_t2/* ./input_t2/t2; echo 'T2 :'; ls input_t2/t2; mkdir OUTDIR; python3 /comete_sc_pmap_fusion/main.py -pmap input_pmap/pmap -t2 input_t2/t2 -output OUTDIR && tar -cvzf [OUTPUT_FILE] OUTDIR

inputs.name: Pmap archive
inputs.description: Archive containing the 2 spinal cord lesion probability maps (upper and lower) produced by comete_sc_T2_STIR for the given exam.

inputs.name: T2 archive
inputs.description: Archive containing the 2 T2Sag images (upper and lower) present in the given exam.

output-files.description: Tarball containing results, written in OUTDIR: combined_image.nii.gz (combination of the upper and lower spinal cord T2 images), combined_pmap.nii.gz (combination of the upper and lower spinal cord probability maps), sc_metrics.tsv (predicted lesion number and volume), and qc.pdf (visual quality check with inputs and outputs for both combined T2 images).
output-files.name: Output archive

custom.method-summary: Method developed by A. Masson and C. Meuree. Original algorithmic details are not documented.
